始.m: to begin; to start; then; only then

应.m: surname Ying; to agree (to do sth); should; ought to

该.m: should; ought to; probably; must be

告.m: (bound form) to say; to tell; to announce; to report; to denounce; to file a lawsuit; to sue

诉.m: to complain; to sue; to tell

准.m: to allow; to grant; in accordance with; in the light of

拿.m: to hold; to seize; to catch; to apprehend

吃.m: to eat; to consume; to eat at (a cafeteria etc); to eradicate; to destroy; to absorb

往.m: to go (in a direction); to; towards; (of a train) bound for

接.m: to receive; to answer (the phone); to meet or welcome sb; to connect

午.m: 7th earthly branch: 11 a.m.-1 p.m., noon, 5th solar month (6th June-6th July), year of the Horse; ancient Chinese compass point: 180° (south)
